environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' with IRSA role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/profile-svc-role-restricted. Calico NetworkPolicy 'profile-svc-egress' applied with spec.egress allowing TCP 443 only to endpoints matching label app.kubernetes.io/component=dynamodb-vpc-endpoint and denying all other egress including to 169.254.169.254/32. IAM policy on the IRSA role includes dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition (ForAllValues:StringEquals on dynamodb:LeadingKeys bound to ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}) restricting item-level access to the caller's tenant partition. Additionally, the DynamoDB VPC endpoint policy restricts dynamodb:Scan action unless aws:PrincipalTag/admin equals 'true'. Node group launch template enforces HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2) with hop limit 1, preventing IRSA-based pods from reaching node IMDS.
